configuration_status: fixed before v2 run; project outcomes and exploratory v1 results already known; not preregistered
initial_design: uniform random without replacement; identical indices for paired BO and random runs
surrogate: Bayesian linear regression with normal-inverse-gamma prior, expressed as a finite feature kernel

prior.observed_center: empirical mean of currently revealed responses; not a random intercept

observed_response_transform: center and scale only currently revealed responses; unit scale if constant
acquisition: posterior latent mean + 1.96*posterior latent std + random.Random(seed).random()*1e-12
batch_selection: top 12 UCB from frozen posterior; seeded random tie-breaking; no within-batch outcome updates
feature_groups_panel: SMILES token-count descriptors and simple structural token descriptors, standardized using the unlabeled candidate pool only

metrics.exact_budget: first batch end reaching observed pool maximum minus tolerance 1e-12
metrics.near_budget: first batch end reaching 0.95*observed pool maximum; not 95th percentile
metrics.target_budget: first batch end reaching predefined historical target; null when no target is in this pool
metrics.cumulative_best: export only at batch ends; do not interpret upstream backfilled best_by_budget within a batch as earlier outcome availability

stopping: exhaust measured pool; global optimum used only by evaluator, never by optimizer or stopping rule
exclusions: PL30 records with different protocols and all substrate-expansion rows excluded from optimization; retained in data audit
scope: three independent catalyst panels and five separate condition grids; no unmeasured cross-product oracle; no fabricated end-to-end catalyst-to-grid transition
known_limitations: single measurement per candidate; algorithmic repeats are not wet-lab replicates
instrument responses are not calibrated yields
later grids are conditioned on historical catalyst selection
no new literature provenance reconstruction or new mechanistic validation in this benchmark
reference_actual_seeds: one reference per strategy per pool, equal to its pool_seed_base

response_standardization.scale: population std ddof=0 of revealed responses; 1.0 if <=1e-12

kernel_feature_standardization: columnwise pool-only population mean/std; zero feature std replaced by 1; no response used
tie_breaking: generate n jitter draws per BO round in candidate-index order including already selected indices; sort remaining by (-acquisition,index)
uncertainty_interpretation: latent-function posterior SD, not future-observation predictive SD; multiplier 1.96 is a heuristic acquisition coefficient, no 95% frequentist coverage guarantee and no prospective calibration claimed
random_reference_diagnostics: posterior diagnostics exported for remaining candidates but never used for random selection; decision_score empty, score_used_for_selection false
initial_reference_diagnostics: unconditioned zero-mean prior and sqrt(diag(K)) exported for all candidates; never used for initial uniform sampling

target_matching.panels: exact catalyst code in historically followed catalyst set; any member counts
target_matching.grids: exact raw cat/ligand/base/solvent tuple within the same grid, no aliases
target_matching.normalization_audit: all exact raw target index sets equal the original v2 normalized sets for these 8 pools; therefore every historical target statistic is preserved
target_matching.unverified_names: CsOH != CsOH/2; DIO is a source abbreviation with unresolved chemical identity

bootstrap.unit: paired replicate index within pool; BO and random share initial sample
bootstrap.sampling: 100 paired differences sampled with replacement per bootstrap replicate
bootstrap.marginal_mean_intervals: same seed and procedure also reported separately for BO and random mean budgets
bootstrap.median_note: paired difference median and marginal medians are descriptive; no median bootstrap interval is claimed
bootstrap.interpretation: algorithmic seed variation conditional on fixed measured pool, not biological/experimental replication; nominal unadjusted per-metric intervals, no multiplicity correction

isolation.observation_boundary: observe accepts exactly the pending selected batch; no full y vector
isolation.oracle_owner: replay driver/evaluator; records and global thresholds are outside optimizer
isolation.export_separation: optimizer_candidates and standardized_features contain no responses or target labels; source_records_and_oracle and evaluation_targets are evaluator files
isolation.scope: code/API data boundary and perturbation tests, not an operating-system sandbox

validation.all_campaigns: new observed-only implementation compared to original v2 full campaign dictionary for each pool/seed/strategy
validation.summaries: all fields of original bo_v2_results.json exactly reproduced
validation.export_integrity: independent CSV reconciliation of all selections, budgets, batch trajectories, reference histories and paired mean intervals

documentation_corrections: old intercept_variance_factor=10 was not executed; actual K=X@X.T
old replicate_seeds=0..99 confused replicate index with actual seed; reference seed column had the same mistake
old report displayed mean-bootstrap interval alongside median saving; interval is now explicitly attached to paired mean saving
old v1 name aliases retained only in immutable snapshot and equality audit, not applied to source labels or target definition
